If your legal team can circulate short notes on those three points ahead of Fri we can shorten the call. Also, please confirm Priya’s timezone (we assume ET).

Thanks — looking forward to the session. I’ll send a calendar invite with dial-in and a brief agenda (redlines 25m, onboarding 15m, procurement next steps 5m).
